operations.details: Verified official HMLR PG40 supplement 6 plan-services guidance.
Plan-related services separated from direct physical measurement.
Polygon/service availability not promoted to vertical accuracy.
Illustrative mapping retained as contextual evidence only.
Verified official HMLR How to read a title register guidance.
Legal register content separated from terrain observation.
Document timestamp retained as legal-state time, not survey epoch.
No register entry promoted to numeric height evidence.
Increment 192 source URLs retained as distinct HMLR contracts.
No register/service value substituted for elevation measurement.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
